findings.title: Merge 小’s early and current “small” sense
findings.details: The article’s opening and learner account give 小 its ordinary meaning “small,” but the early-use record 小:small is marked historical while a duplicate current record carries the present use. Merge them under 小:small and retain both the reported early attestation and current-use evidence. The current relationship list also has separate has_sense edges for the duplicate records; regenerate it from the merged sense.
findings.verification: Confirm the merged 小:small record is current, cites X-7c4ee97c98a3f9f753ae for the reported early use and E6/E7 for current use, and is the only has_sense edge for that use. Obtain fresh factual and readability approvals for the changed article.

findings.title: Represent the 小–少 shared-graph claim without a variant direction
findings.details: The relationship predicate is variant_of, while its text and cited analyses describe a shared early graph followed by differentiation and explicitly avoid derivation in either direction. The predicate may assert a narrower relationship than the evidence supports.
findings.verification: Review the cited graphic analyses and select a predicate that represents shared-graph differentiation without asserting an unsupported variant direction. If the relationship changes, obtain fresh factual review.
